nature_language: 当前位置武汉。我两个人想坐火车去广州玩3天，预算5000人民币，喜欢自然风光，住一间有智能客控的大床房，市内打车，人均吃饭每顿不超过80，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Wuhan. Two of us want to take a train to Guangzhou for a 3-day trip with a budget of 5,000 RMB. We enjoy natural scenery and would like to stay in a hotel with a smart control system in a room with a large bed. We plan to take taxis within the city, and our meal budget is no more than 80 RMB per person per meal. Please provide a travel itinerary.
